summary: 1.0.62 on macOS 26.6.2, /dev/cu.usbserial-1420 and /dev/tty.usbserial-1420. EINVAL before any radio traffic (no trace), so pyserial open/termios/RTS-DTR ioctl was rejected by the adapter driver at 115200. Same owner's IC-F60V capture worked in the Web Programmer, possibly with a different cable. App shows the raw errno instead of a cable/driver explanation.
title: macOS read fails at port open with (22, 'Invalid argument')
